interpretation: The ideal nine-qubit protocol has twelve independent deterministic output relations. The three removed legacy detector directions are PPM-to-final-joint consistency; an encoded logical X after the first split triggers legacy D395 but no slabs detector. One-round distance1 is therefore a documented consequence of protecting these logical outputs instead of using them as decoder checks. Three rounds recover distance3 in this audited circuit.
